active_cap.scope: offense + defense Custom Adjustments combined (Aidan rule, user games)
active_cap.note: EA Madden 27 allows 20 saved per side and 10 active per game (EA gameplay deep dive) — honor Aidan's 8, same as CFB 27. CPU games = offense-only (O macros only).
active_cap.in_game_open: LB at the line (also shown at the top of the play-call menu when holding the play button)

field_legend.approx: Setting labels are Aidan-language approximations — EA documents the categories (fronts, leverage, coverage behavior, protection, pressure looks, route concepts, hot routes, individual assignments) but not exact option names; confirm in-game

split_field_zone.why: explosive-shot + scramble persona — keep MATCH-4 / SPY

doctrine: Do NOT auto-arm a macro from one concept appearance — most snaps Nickel Over Cover 4 Quarters / Cover 3 Match / Tampa 2 with no macro (rush four, drop seven).
